wages.text: Bera has advocated raising the federal minimum wage so full-time workers are not left in poverty.
wages.quote: If we raise the minimum wage to $10.10 an hour, we can restore fairness for working men and women, and make sure no one who works full time lives in poverty.

trade.text: Bera opposed President Trump's sweeping tariffs, saying they raised costs and strained alliances, and has defended free-trade agreements.
trade.quote: raised costs for working families, hurt small businesses, and strained our alliances around the world

debt.text: Bera supports strengthening Social Security and Medicare and opposes efforts to cut or weaken the programs.
debt.quote: That is why I have supported the Social Security 2100 Act to strengthen Social Security and improve benefits, and why I will continue fighting to protect both Social Security and Medicare from efforts to weaken or undermine them.

housing.text: Bera voted for legislation intended to expand housing supply, cut red tape, and finance construction of more homes.
housing.quote: In Congress, I voted for the Housing for the 21st Century Act, a major package focused on expanding housing supply, lowering costs, cutting red tape, modernizing HUD programs, and unlocking financing to help build more homes.

schools.text: Bera says he has opposed education-funding cuts and supports protecting and strengthening public education.
schools.quote: I believe we have to protect and strengthen public education at every level, from K-12 schools to community colleges and universities, so that the same opportunities I had are still available to the next generation.

safety.text: Bera voted to fund both additional law-enforcement personnel and prevention-oriented programs such as mental-health response and violence intervention.
safety.quote: I voted for bipartisan legislation to increase funding for law enforcement and public safety programs, including support for officer recruitment and retention, homicide investigations, mental health first responder units, and evidence-based violence intervention programs.

immigration.text: Bera introduced legislation to create a pathway to permanent residency for Dreamers and documented Dreamers.
immigration.quote: They are stepping up, serving their communities, and doing their part to make our country stronger.

guns.text: Bera voted for expanded background checks and bipartisan gun-violence prevention legislation.
guns.quote: The American people have pleaded for commonsense action to prevent gun violence

abortion.text: Bera voted for the Women's Health Protection Act to codify abortion rights after Roe was overturned and opposes restrictions.
abortion.quote: The freedom to make the most intensely personal and often hardest decision of a woman's life should not be subject to the political inclination and ideology of politicians in Washington.

health.text: Bera supports universal coverage and has voted to expand ACA subsidies, cap insulin costs, and let Medicare negotiate drug prices.
health.quote: I support universal coverage so every American has access to affordable, quality health care.

energy.text: Bera voted for the Inflation Reduction Act, calling it the largest climate investment in U.S. history.
energy.quote: This bill will also make the single largest climate investment in U.S. history to protect the health of our environment and families and further our transition to a clean energy future while creating millions of new good-paying jobs.

voting.text: Bera opposed the SAVE America Act’s voting restrictions, saying they would burden eligible voters.
voting.quote: These burdensome restrictions would make it harder for eligible Americans to vote and would disproportionately impact seniors, people with disabilities, rural voters, low-income Americans, and working families.

safety.text: Tucker said he would support law enforcement and emphasized holding people who violate the law accountable.
safety.quote: And I would do everything I can to support law enforcement.

immigration.text: Tucker described immigration as a public-safety issue and called for bringing people who violate the law to justice and holding them accountable.
immigration.quote: We need to focus on the public safety side, bringing to justice and holding accountable those who violate the law.

guns.text: Tucker said he supports the Second Amendment.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Tucker supports the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act to set athletics and privacy rules by sex.
gender.quote: Robb supports this bill to clarify Title IX protections, ensuring fairness in women's and girls' athletics and protecting sex-based privacy in schools
